summary: Authenticate complete conversation discovery cursors and keep detail and restart continuations usable

schema.detail: Existing opaque cursor and read fields are retained.

rules.detail: The existing authenticated continuation mechanism now covers the full discovery payload before its snapshot is trusted. Reencoded foreign-grant, keyset or expiry modifications are rejected.

compatibility.detail: Detail preview cursors continue through the timeline tool. Pinned discovery rows for restarted sessions retain metadata with a null read handle rather than failing the whole page.
